question: Shikha sells a bookshelf to Vansh at a loss of 5%, Vansh sells the same bookshelf to Swarnima at a profit of 10%, and Swarnima sells the same bookshelf to Nikhil at a loss of 20%. If Nikhil purchased the bookshelf for ₹16,720, then what was the cost (in ₹) of the bookshelf for Shikha?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the successive fraction multiplier method for chained profit/loss:

Loss of 5% → 19/20 | Profit of 10% → 11/10 | Loss of 20% → 4/5

Initial CP × (19/20) × (11/10) × (4/5) = Final SP

Initial CP × (836/1000) = 16720

Initial CP = 16720 × (1000/836) = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20,000.**
